test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Reena. Meena. Tina, Leena, and Neena are sitting in a straight line facing south. Tina is sitting to the immediate right of Reena. Only Neena is sitting between Reena and Leena. Tina is not sitting in the end. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Neena?
solution:
Given: Reena. Meena. Tina, Leena, and Neena are sitting in a straight line facing south.

1) Tina is sitting to the immediate right of Reena.

2) Only Neena is sitting between Reena and Leena.

3) Tina is not sitting in the end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be06563a28336a79287e0b4f910274f521a59760b1adc3942b6c3e9fdbb0a697.png] 

And, Meena is sitting at the remaining position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c563fd941d5e49ac6a0c0bc8337c02d23c8e8a65bc114bb4caffb3bca4bf0b8.png] 

Here, 'Leena' is sitting to the immediate left of Neena.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Leena"**.
